name: runway-try-the-look
description: Nike-branded streetwear outfit runway with Node.js, Express and MongoDB

scripts.seed: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {connectDB}=require('./src/config/db'); const {seedProducts}=require('./src/seed'); const {seedLooks}=require('./src/seedLooks'); (async()=>{await connectDB(); await seedProducts(); await seedLooks(); console.log('Seed complete'); process.exit(0);})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});"
